people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “Yahweh will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”
translations.bsb: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, “May the LORD hold David’s enemies accountable.”
translations.kjv: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the LORD even require it at the hand of David's enemies.
translations.asv: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, And Jehovah will require it at the hand of David's enemies.
